tools.name: get_part107_sample_questions
tools.description: Return the FAA Part 107 ACS exam blueprint (60-question topic weights, 70% pass score, 120-minute limit) and a deterministic selection of free sample practice questions without exposing answer keys. Call grade_part107_answers to score responses.

tools.name: grade_part107_answers
tools.description: Deterministically grade answers to free sample Part 107 questions against 14 CFR Part 107 and FAA ACS references, returning pass/fail status (70% threshold), per-topic breakdown, weakest knowledge area, and rule explanations.

tools.name: decode_part107_metar
tools.description: Deterministically parse a raw aviation METAR, SPECI, or TAF report into plain English and evaluate FAA 14 CFR 107.51(c)-(d) visibility (3 SM) and cloud-clearance (500 ft below ceiling) minimums for small UAS flight.
